description: Fine-tuning config. init_adapter starts new training with saved LoRA weights; output.resume_from_checkpoint restores full Trainer state.

run_id.description: Operation UUID; assigned by the host when omitted.

model.description: Catalog base model ID or local adapter directory containing adapter_config.json and adapter_model.safetensors. The adapter base must be in the catalog.

init_adapter.description: Local LoRA checkpoint to post-train. Inherits saved rank, alpha, targets and dropout; resets optimizer and step counter. Requires a separate output directory.

kind.description: Automatically select CUDA or require CUDA explicitly.

judge_model.description: Reserved judge model; unused by offline SFT/DPO/ORPO/CPO.

data.description: Dataset source and mapping: hf, local, synthetic, klayer or multi, following run.yaml.

train_dataset.description: Optional alias for a local training dataset (.jsonl, .parquet, or Dataset Fabric .json manifest).

val_dataset.description: Optional independent local validation dataset (.jsonl, .parquet, or Dataset Fabric .json manifest). Must not overlap training files or shards.

adapter.description: Settings for a NEW adapter. Saved structure is inherited on continuation.

type.description: New adapter kind: lora, qlora or dora.

quant_bits.description: Base model loading precision: 4, 16 or null. Never automatically lowered.

optim.description: Optimizer settings; omitted fields use MCP defaults.

grad_accumulation_steps.description: Microbatches per optimizer step; effective batch is preserved when micro-batch is reduced.

gradient_accumulation_steps.description: Alias for grad_accumulation_steps; conflicting aliases are rejected.

max_steps.description: Optimizer step budget; full resume uses a total target.

epochs.description: Epoch budget when max_steps is null.

max_seq_len.description: Maximum sequence length; never automatically reduced.

packing.description: Auto packs sampled short SFT sequences only when boundary isolation is supported.

completion_only_loss.description: Train only on assistant completion tokens for SFT (default true).

performance.description: Execution overrides; do not change training steps, sequence length, rank, or effective batch.

adapter_materialization_device.description: LoRA materialization; CUDA requires verified free-memory headroom.

merge_shard_size.description: MergeKit shard size in parameter units.

pin_memory.description: Automatic or explicit pin memory override.

merge_cuda.description: Automatic or explicit merge cuda override.

merge_low_cpu_memory.description: Automatic or explicit merge low cpu memory override.

dataloader_workers.description: Automatic or explicit dataloader workers count.

prefetch_factor.description: Automatic or explicit prefetch factor count.

cpu_threads.description: Automatic or explicit cpu threads count.

adapter_path.description: Directory for new checkpoints and final adapter.

resume_from_checkpoint.description: Full Trainer checkpoint: requires adapter weights, trainer_state.json, optimizer.pt, scheduler.pt and rng_state.pth. Restores global_step; max_steps is the total target. Mutually exclusive with init_adapter.

resume_from.description: Deprecated alias for resume_from_checkpoint; never means weights-only continuation.
